column1: # What was decided for a function's differences in a case (case and function may be *): Kiousu's decisions

# being done and doesn't raise the case for a decision again while every culprit row is covered here.

column3: start the region counts at zero (the intended design)
column5: Kiousu: replicate the original's intent, not the shipped uninitialized buffer

column3: REVOLT slots start at -1; take = round(100*(1 - prod(1 - c/100))), pick when time%100 < take; nearest-faction distance uses each base's own owner's treaty (the intended design)
column5: Kiousu: the documented REVOLT 75%; fix the slips

column3: Sealurks pay the normal sea cost entering fungus on the ocean shelf, as Isle of the Deep does (upstream's fix, kept)
another faction's air drop notice names the nearest base the player at the controls owns or has seen (not faction 1's), and leaves the name blank on purpose when there is none (no Bases[-1] read)

column3: an aircraft on alert returning to its home airbase is checked against that airbase's own distance (not the shortest distance found before it)
column5: Kiousu: action_home uses the airbase's own distance
